name: gbadisasm
notes: Built from source at pinned commit with make (bundled Capstone 3.0.5-rc2, ARM only). Binary sha256 59243b0f3d8b4ac48d9fa2325565257082fb1d9dcf2557501fac22a1535221b7. test.sh assembles a tiny ARM+Thumb ROM with arm-none-eabi-as/ld/objcopy (Homebrew), runs gbadisasm with a config, and greps output for thumb_func_start, muls, svc #3 and the literal-pool ldr.
